messages.subject: shiny app deployment error.
messages.body_plain:
Iam deploying my shiny app to shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io> & all my app files(app.r,www) are all stored in my dropbox. I have loaded the rsconnect command then published the app to my account. The deployment process is successful but when I go to my app url I get the following error:

messages.subject: Re: Error on publishing my app in shinyio
messages.subject_clean: Error on publishing my app in shinyio
messages.body_plain:
I am loading shape files from my dropox. I have encoded the whole R file & specific shape files to UTF-8 but still the same error as shown persists.

On Thursday, July 14, 2016 at 6:02:20 PM UTC+3, Joshua Spiewak wrote:
> This article <http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/unicode.html> might be useful.
>
> This ticket <https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/1245> I opened is with the shiny package itself, and you are welcome to watch it.
>
> On Thursday, July 14, 2016 at 10:44:49 AM UTC-4, Joshua Spiewak wrote:
> > My apologies for the less than useful error message.
> >
> > After digging into this, I think the issue is that you have a data file whose encoding is 'latin1', which is likely the default for your local environment which is why it works there. On shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io> the default is UTF-8. You can either convert the file, or when you load it specify the encoding.
> >
> > I will be filing a ticket internally so that this error is reported in a way that makes it more obvious what is going wrong.
> >
